# proxmox_sdn_controller (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN controller from `/cluster/sdn/controllers`. Fields without a typed counterpart stay in `pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_controller" "evpn" {
  controller = proxmox_sdn_controller.evpn.controller
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `controller` (String) Controller to read.

### Read-Only

- `asn` (Number)
- `fabric` (String)
- `id` (String) Controller identifier.
- `loopback` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `nodes` (List of String)
- `peers` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `route_map_in` (String)
- `route_map_out` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
